 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Oct 28, 2026, 05:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Unfinished office work can finally be cleared for Sagittarius this Wednesday. The Moon moves through Rohini in Taurus, your sixth house of daily work, where it is exalted. It is Budhwar, the day of Mercury, which rules your tenth house of career. Mercury is retrograde in your eleventh, a position that favours finishing old tasks over starting new ones. Kantaka Shani continues its retrograde in your fourth. Exalted Moon in the Sixth
 The sixth house governs routine duties and service. With the Moon strong here, you have the patience for tasks that usually feel tedious, such as reconciling expenses or replying to a backlog of emails. Rohini’s steady, growing energy helps you work through a long list one item at a time. Budhwar and Retrograde Mercury
 Mercury rules your seventh and tenth houses, so its retrograde touches career and clients. Pending items from September, such as an unfinished report or a client query left unanswered, may resurface. Clear them today. Double-check figures and recipients before sending, as a retrograde Mercury makes small slips likely. Jupiter’s Protection from the Eighth
 Exalted Jupiter, your ruler, keeps setbacks small. Debilitated Mars beside it may make you rush to finish. Pace yourself to avoid errors. Home and the Fourth
 Retrograde Shani in your fourth may pull you towards a household task just as office deadlines press. Finish the office list first, then give the evening to home. Do’s for Today
 Clear one backlog item at a time.
 Double-check figures and recipients before sending.
 Don’ts for Today
 Avoid starting new projects this week.
 Do not rush to finish at the cost of accuracy.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Donate a working printer to a local school. Offer modak to Ganesha on Wednesday morning.
